title: Crash when clicking on shader in material
body:
### Tested versions

4.5 stable, 4.6dev

### System information

Ubuntu 24.04 Nvidia

### Issue description

Compatibility mode. After clicking on a shader in a ShaderMaterial, Godot crashes:
